items.title: Uneven monsoons, El Nino pose upside risks to inflation; another RBI hike possible: Report

items.title: India needs to create high-quality jobs, increase productivity growth: IMF
items.summary: The International Monetary Fund has upgraded India's potential growth to 6.8 percent, citing favorable demographics and a growing economy. The IMF continues to view India as a key growth engine for the global economy.
